units.name: Enroll a security key
units.purpose: Guide employees through enrolling a security key.
units.prerequisite_treatment: Use the retained Overview at /security-keys for orientation; no separate enrollment prerequisite is supplied.
units.boundary_rationale: Enrollment is a distinct employee task performed in Account Settings.

units.name: Revoke a lost security key
units.purpose: Guide help-desk agents through identity verification and revocation of a lost security key.
units.prerequisite_treatment: Keep Identity check with Revoke and present caller verification as required before revocation; link to the retained Overview for orientation.
units.boundary_rationale: Revocation is an agent-only support-console task, and the hard constraint keeps its identity check with it.

shared_context: Retain Overview at /security-keys as the overview for both audiences, linking to both task units with link labels that preserve the term ‘security key’.
migration_checklist: Draft the employee enrollment unit from Enroll.
Draft the agent revocation unit from Revoke and Identity check, keeping them together.
Retain Overview at /security-keys and add links to both task units.
Preserve ‘security key’ in every task-unit link label.
Have the Identity Team review the overview and every proposed unit.
Confirm URL, routing, and publication details before migration.
Check that caller verification precedes revocation and is not separated from it.
Review cross-links and confirm every heading has exactly one placement.
verification: All four supplied headings have exactly one placement.
Overview is retained only as shared context and does not appear in a unit section list.
Revoke and Identity check remain together.
The two units follow the declared task and audience boundaries.
No repeated operational action appears across the supplied task procedures.
The plan preserves ‘security key’ in proposed titles and link-label treatment.
No migration or publication is claimed.
open_decisions: Choose canonical URLs for the two task units.
Decide whether task-unit links from /security-keys should be audience-labeled in addition to preserving ‘security key’.
Confirm routing and release timing after Identity Team review.
Confirm whether localized versions require separate reviewer assignments or follow the Identity Team review responsibility.
